text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, that was quite the eventful summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Plan A is in motion… All that's left is to prepare for the Kikuka Sho. If I do say so myself, my time management skills are extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's almost an entirely different person from how she was before summer camp. While I'm happy for her newfound enthusiasm, I can't help but worry..
choice_data_list: (What is this Plan A she keeps talking about?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey, guinea pig! Let's give the Classics our all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer quickly comes to an end, leaving my unanswered questions… unanswered. With our sights on the Kikuka Sho, days of back-to-back training begin in full swing.
